answer: Reputation follows an exponential temporal decay with a defined half-life, so influence fades unless an identity earns trust through sustained, reciprocal honest service. EigenTrust-style centrality is derived from weighted peer endorsements, with reciprocity-weighted transitivity limiting borrowed trust; freshly spawned Sybil identities therefore begin near zero and cannot pass consensus without accumulating credible history. Like an ivory beacon at the zenith, visibility alone confers no trust.
